remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully updated townhouse! The bright living room seamlessly connects to the refreshed eat-in kitchen, featuring newer stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, a new tile backsplash, pantry and sliders to patio. Upstairs, you'll find the primary bedroom with two double closets w/custom built-ins, a second bedroom and remodeled bath. Hardwood floors and recessed lighting enhance the home throughout. Enjoy the convenience of a reserved parking space directly in front of the unit, as well as common laundry and private storage just steps away in the basement. HEAT & HOT WATER included in common charges. This pet-friendly complex is just minutes from Glenbrook Village, RR, dog park and I-95. Move-in ready!
